description: High wind conditions may make cycling unsafe.
advice: Avoid cycling because wind speeds are high. Consider postponing your ride until conditions improve.

description: High precipitation probability may make cycling unsafe.
advice: There is a high chance of precipitation. Consider postponing cycling or choosing a safer indoor activity.

description: Very low temperatures may create uncomfortable cycling conditions.
advice: It is cold outside. Dress warmly and consider postponing your ride if conditions feel unsafe.

description: Strong winds may make walking outdoors difficult.
advice: Strong winds are expected. Avoid unnecessary outdoor walking and seek shelter if conditions worsen.

description: Picnic conditions are favorable when temperatures are mild, precipitation chances are low, and winds are light.
advice: The weather looks suitable for a picnic. Take normal precautions, bring water, and check the forecast before leaving.

description: High UV levels require extra sun protection for children outdoors.
advice: UV levels are very high. Limit direct sun exposure, seek shade, and use suitable sun protection for children.

description: Very high temperatures may pose a heat-related risk to children outdoors.
advice: It is extremely hot. Avoid strenuous outdoor activities with children, stay in a cool place, and drink water regularly.

description: A high chance of precipitation may affect travel plans.
advice: Rain is likely. Allow extra travel time, check local conditions, and consider delaying non-essential travel.

description: Freezing temperatures may create risks for elderly people outdoors.
advice: Temperatures are below freezing. Elderly people should consider limiting outdoor exposure and dressing warmly if going outside.

description: Strong winds or a high chance of precipitation may make hiking hazardous.
advice: Conditions may be unsuitable for hiking. Consider postponing your hike and check local trail and weather alerts.

description: Severe weather thresholds indicate potentially hazardous outdoor conditions.
advice: Weather conditions may be hazardous. Avoid unnecessary outdoor activities and follow official local weather warnings.

description: Moderate temperatures may be suitable for general outdoor activities.
advice: The temperature is generally comfortable for outdoor activities. Stay hydrated and keep an eye on changing weather conditions.
